audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Ambessa's dash 'Dash Chain' in eleven places. There is no such ability in her kit.
audit.why: Her dash is Drakehound's Step (P), and Riot's text gives the arming condition the page never states: 'Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast.' The dash is a rider on a cast, not a standalone button, which is exactly why Miasma timing works — you ground the cast, not a separate dash. Also absent: Repudiation (W) shields her before the slam, so burst thrown into her brace is eaten, and Public Execution (R) blinks to the FARTHEST enemy champion in the line.
audit.corrected: Every 'Dash Chain' replaced with Drakehound's Step, the move-command arming condition stated, and Repudiation's shield plus Public Execution's farthest-target rule added.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicts its own prose at four stages. win[0] says Cassiopeia while whys[0] says Ambessa 'wins the level-1 exchange outright'; win[3] says Skill while whys[3] and the mid text call 4-5 'your takeover'; win[4] says Cassiopeia while spikes[2], whys[4] and the mid text all say 6 is her kill window; win[5] says Skill while spikes[3] and the late text call the first-item window 'hers'.
audit.why: The prose is right in all four cases and the chart is wrong. Ambessa has a point-and-click damage ability and a dash at 1 while Cassiopeia has one Noxious Blast and no poison primed; Cassiopeia takes over at 4-5 once ranked Q and E chain refunded Twin Fangs against a grounded target; Ambessa owns 6 and the first bruiser item; Cassiopeia reclaims at two items, which is what the mirrored Ambessa audit also concludes.
audit.corrected: win[0]=Ambessa, win[3]=Cassiopeia, win[4]=Ambessa, win[5]=Ambessa, and the matching full-layer phase sides and whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both ultimates are discussed with no cooldowns, so 'hold R for her all-in' has no timer attached to it.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s and Public Execution is 130/115/100s. Cassiopeia's ultimate comes back faster than Ambessa's at every rank, so a traded pair of ults favours Cassiopeia unless the dive kills — this is the same conclusion the mirrored Ambessa audit reached from the other side, and stating it makes the level 6 advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Ultimate cooldowns added to breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d and report[9].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1], dosFull[2], dontsFull[0], dontsFull[1] and dontsFull[2] all carry bodies that do not describe their own headings, several of them cloned verbatim from the Aatrox page.
audit.why: dosFull[1] is headed 'Face the engage so R stuns, not slows' — the single most important line in the matchup — but its body is the Aatrox trade text and never mentions the facing rule. dosFull[2] is headed "E-spam him while he's grounded" with a body about Ambessa spending her dash. dontsFull[1] is headed 'Get flanked with R already spent' with a body about Miasma.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to their headings, with the Petrifying Gaze facing rule finally stated where its heading promises it.

notes: Ambessa's kit file flags grounding on Repudiation (W) and grounding plus healing on Public Execution (R). Riot's own descriptions for both contain none of that — W is shield/brace/slam, R is blink/suppress/stun — so I treated those as tooltip-parse misfires and asserted none of them. That also means the _missing-interactions entry 'Ambessa sustains through chip damage (Public Execution (R))' is unsupported and I did not act on it; the shield entry for Repudiation is supported and I did add that. MIRROR: audits/top/ambessa__cassiopeia.json existed and I reused its findings — Petrifying Gaze 120s vs Public Execution 130s, the facing rule, Miasma 24s to 16s, and its conclusion that Cassiopeia reclaims the lane at two items. One thing to check for mirror consistency: I set Level 6 and First item to Ambessa on this side, so the Ambessa page must show the same two stages as hers.
